subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-11-09
html:
Found and fixed a live bug: three pages were telling Google and AI crawlers that ARLO charges $19–$499/mo, when the real /pricing page says ARLO is completely free during early access with no paid tiers yet. Rank/backlinks still flat (28th straight session, 0/22 tracked keywords; backlinks 3/2) — this is a trust/accuracy fix, not a ranking lever by itself.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
HomepageReplaced a fabricated 6-tier AggregateOffer ($0–$499, each linking to a /#pricing anchor that doesn't exist) with a single accurate $0 Offer linking to the real /pricing page.AI-answer-engine pricing citation (no single keyword)askarlo.app — view page source, search for application/ld+json
All 6 /services/* persona pagesSame fix, via the shared getSoftwareApplicationSchema() helper these pages all render.FOCUS cluster conversion funnel (connector-matrix personas)askarlo.app/services/google-ads-specialist — view page source
/pricingIts own JSON-LD carried the identical fabricated 6-tier offer, directly contradicting that same page's visible "free during early access" copy — fixed to match.arlo pricingaskarlo.app/pricing — view page source

Why this and not more FOCUS-cluster content: the connector matrix (5/5) and comparison hub (5/5) are re-confirmed fully built out for an 11th straight session — no new keyword-driven page to ship. While re-checking Thursday's schema-wiring fix, found it had sourced pricing from a dead, unused data file instead of the live /pricing page, reintroducing the same pricing-drift problem llms.txt was fixed for back at kickoff. A correctness bug beats a content/polish pass.

Next: the two files behind the bug (pricingTiers, Pricing.tsx) are confirmed fully dead code — flagged for deletion in a future session. FOCUS and both gated catalogs stay exhausted; re-pulling fresh each session. Everything else open (GSC sitemap submission, off-page listings, AI Result Tracker LLM engine config, CSP, www redirect, second testimonial, and verifying ChatGPT-connector compatibility before ever claiming it) remains a human decision.
